newsitem.title: PERU: Peru mudslide kills at least 12 in minivan.
newsitem.headline: Peru mudslide kills at least 12 in minivan.

text.p: At least 12 people died when a mudslide slammed into a minivan travelling through the Peruvian Andes late on Sunday, police said on Monday.
"The earth slid down and buried the minivan," policeman Alberto Rojas told Reuters, adding that the vehicle was carrying at least 15 passengers.
He denied radio reports that the vehicle was a passeneger bus with 35 people on board. Minivans carrying peasants in the Andes usually hold up to about 20 people.
By Monday afternoon, rescue workers had recovered 12 bodies from the accident site near the mountain town of Abancay, 600 miles (960 km) southeast of Lima, Rojas said.
At least 300 peasants were killed by mudslides in the same area last month.
